en.title: F-C-G
en.decryption: Remember the sequence: The Chinese pilgrim Faxian (F) visited during the reign of Chandragupta II (C) of the Gupta (G) era.

hi.title: F-C-G
hi.decryption: Remember the sequence: The Chinese pilgrim Faxian (F) visited during the reign of Chandragupta II (C) of the Gupta (G) era.

fact.en: Faxian NEVER mentions the name of the king (Chandragupta II) in his accounts; he only records his experience of the administration.
fact.hi: Faxian NEVER mentions the name of the king (Chandragupta II) in his accounts; he only records his experience of the administration.

fact.en: Faxian's focus was purely religious (Buddhism); do not expect detailed political accounts like those found in Megasthenes' Indika.
fact.hi: Faxian's focus was purely religious (Buddhism); do not expect detailed political accounts like those found in Megasthenes' Indika.

fact.en: Confusing Faxian (5th Century) with Xuanzang (7th Century - Harshavardhana period).
fact.hi: Confusing Faxian (5th Century) with Xuanzang (7th Century - Harshavardhana period).
